_note: LLM-generated factor candidates (Claude acting as the LLM) using the expanded 120-factor Kelly pool + field dictionary. Each targets a NEW characteristic not in the old curated-38, with an asset-pricing rationale. Fed to adapter/factor_report.py --from-json.

factors.name: cash_prof_accrual_quality
factors.rationale: Ball et al. (2016): cash-based operating profitability predicts returns and subsumes accruals; Sloan (1996): high operating accruals signal low earnings quality. Long real (cash-backed) profitability with low accruals and disciplined equity issuance.

factors.name: pead_earnings_revenue_surprise
factors.rationale: Post-earnings-announcement drift: standardized unexpected earnings and revenue surprises predict continued drift; revenue surprise confirms the earnings signal is real. Guard against one-month reversal.

factors.name: ev_value_cash_profitability
factors.rationale: Enterprise-multiple value (EBIT to book enterprise value, Loughran-Wellman) is cleaner than book-to-market for levered firms; combined with cash profitability and restrained asset growth (q-theory investment).

factors.name: low_duration_quality
factors.rationale: Dechow et al. (2004) / Weber (2018): low equity duration (near-term cash flows) earns a value-like premium; Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen quality; lower market beta. Safe, cash-now, high-quality firms.

factors.name: profitability_minus_lottery
factors.rationale: Bali et al. (2011) MAX/lottery effect and Ang et al. (2006) idiosyncratic-volatility anomaly: high-MAX, high-idio-vol stocks underperform. Long cash-profitable, non-lottery, low-idio-vol names.

factors.name: accrual_investment_discipline
factors.rationale: Total accruals (Richardson et al. 2005) and asset growth (Cooper et al. 2008) are overinvestment / low-quality signals; cash profitability is the real-earnings counterweight.

factors.name: distress_adjusted_value
factors.rationale: Value works better among financially healthy firms (Piotroski 2000; Campbell-Hilscher-Szilagyi distress): cheap plus high Altman-Z plus low idiosyncratic risk avoids the distressed value trap.

factors.name: shareholder_yield_quality
factors.rationale: Net payout yield (Boudoukh et al. 2007) plus cash profitability, penalizing equity issuance: firms returning cash and generating real profits rather than diluting shareholders.

factors.name: earnings_streak_momentum
factors.rationale: Earnings-increase streaks (Loh-Warachka earnings momentum) plus price momentum, guarded against short-term reversal: fundamental and price underreaction reinforce each other.

factors.name: quality_bloat_value
factors.rationale: Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen quality (profitability plus safety) tilted toward cheap sales-to-price with low net operating assets (Hirshleifer et al. bloated-balance-sheet / NOA anomaly).
